'''Hover platforms''', or '''foot speeders''' were a type of personal [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repuslorcraft]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Constructed around a small, disk-shaped [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pad, the platform was designed for use by a single operator. The craft was controlled by a steering vane extending vertically from its base.<ref name="EV" />

==History==
During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] utilized a hover platform while personally leading a segment of Imperials to conduct a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] on [[Spaceport THX1138]], after the discovery of a Rebel spy on one of the ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' transports.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hover Platform appears in only one of the two possible opening scenes of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ST2" /> The platform also came as part of an action figure set by [[Hasbro]], known as Ambush at Star Tours, where it came with Darth Vader, two [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Sky Troopers]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=Ambush at STAR TOURS|altlink=https://www.banthaskull.com/photo_galleries/gallery/ph_ambush_at_star_tours}}</ref>
